FinTech Society, UAL — Treasurer & Acting Vice President (2024 – Present)
  • Oversee society finances, budgeting, and event planning for a growing student-led FinTech community
  • Spearhead engagement initiatives and first-year outreach
  • Organize speaker events exploring blockchain, digital banking, and AI in finance

  • Founded a blog championing women in technology through interviews, insights, and stories from the field
  • Conduct interviews with researchers and professionals

💫 About Me

Hi! I'm Krystyna Wells, a second-year Computer Science student at the University of the Arts London. I’m passionate about combining creativity and technology — from building IoT systems to exploring AI for design and interaction. Currently, I’m the Treasurer of the FinTech Society, and I love collaborating on hands-on tech projects.

IoT Desk Health Helper
IoT, ESP8266, MQTT, Python
An IoT-based desk health assistant that helps promote healthier study and work habits. The system reminds users to stay hydrated, maintain a good sitting distance from the screen, and ensure a comfortable workspace environment.
